columns: actor_update_subscription.created_at timestamp with time zone null=NO default=now()
actor_update_subscription.last_run_at timestamp with time zone null=YES default=
actor_update_subscription.next_due_at timestamp with time zone null=YES default=
actor_update_subscription.updated_at timestamp with time zone null=NO default=now()
actor_update_subscription_run.created_at timestamp with time zone null=NO default=now()
comments: column actor_update_subscription.requested_by: Who asked for this subscription. NULL until authentication exists; shown as "Not Recorded". Never defaulted, never inferred.
constraint actor_update_subscription.ck_actor_update_subscription_scope: A subscription with no scope would sweep everything, which is the behaviour opt-in subscriptions replace.
constraints: actor_update_subscription.ck_actor_update_subscription_scope [c] CHECK (((COALESCE(cardinality(actor_ids), 0) > 0) OR (COALESCE(cardinality(sector_codes), 0) > 0) OR (COALESCE(cardinality(topic_ids), 0) > 0) OR (NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(country, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) OR (state_code IS NOT NULL) OR (region_code IS NOT NULL) OR (NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(city, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)))
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_actor_update_subscription_due ON public.actor_update_subscription USING btree (next_due_at) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)
CREATE INDEX ix_actor_update_subscription_run_run ON public.actor_update_subscription_run USING btree (collection_run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_actor_update_subscription_status ON public.actor_update_subscription USING btree (status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX actor_update_subscription_pkey ON public.actor_update_subscription USING btree (actor_update_subscription_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX actor_update_subscription_run_pkey ON public.actor_update_subscription_run USING btree (actor_update_subscription_id, collection_run_id)
triggers: actor_update_subscription_run.actor_update_subscription_run_append_only -> ghus_guard_subscription_run_append_only enabled=O CREATE TRIGGER actor_update_subscription_run_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.actor_update_subscription_run FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ghus_guard_subscription_run_append_only()

comments: column actor_update_subscription.focus_terms: Sub-topic terms that narrow the search within the sector or topic. At most 8.
column actor_update_subscription.max_new_actors_per_run: Ceiling on new actors one run may stage; bounds review load and cost.
constraints: collection_run.ck_collection_run_cadence [c] CHECK (((cadence IS NULL) OR (cadence = ANY (ARRAY['once'::text, 'weekly'::text, 'biweekly'::text, 'monthly'::text, 'quarterly'::text])))) NOT VALID NOT VALID
collection_run.ck_collection_run_cadence [c] CHECK (((cadence IS NULL) OR (cadence = ANY (ARRAY['once'::text, 'weekly'::text, 'monthly'::text, 'quarterly'::text])))) NOT VALID NOT VALID

comments: constraint actor_verification_event.ck_actor_verification_event_origin: ghus_review = a person; existing_canonical_migration = pre-V2 carry-over; agent_auto_accept = the discovery agent accepted it on score and quality gates (verify only, reasons required).
constraints: actor_verification_event.ck_actor_verification_event_origin [c] CHECK ((((decision_origin = 'ghus_review'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim(decided_by), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (migration_batch_id IS NULL)) OR ((decision_origin = 'existing_canonical_migration'::text) AND (decision = 'verified'::text) AND (decided_by IS NULL) AND (decided_at IS NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(migration_batch_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (topic_id IS NULL)) OR ((decision_origin = 'agent_auto_accept'::text) AND (decision = 'verified'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim(decided_by), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(reason), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (migration_batch_id IS NULL))))

actor_verification_event.ck_actor_verification_event_origin [c] CHECK ((((decision_origin = 'ghus_review'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim(decided_by), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (migration_batch_id IS NULL)) OR ((decision_origin = 'existing_canonical_migration'::text) AND (decision = 'verified'::text) AND (decided_by IS NULL) AND (decided_at IS NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(migration_batch_id), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (topic_id IS NULL))))

comments: column actor_update_subscription.max_usd_per_run: Actor update requests only: the spend ceiling of one run, in USD.

column actor_update_subscription.update_options: Actor update requests only: what to re-read (scope, depth, categories, boxes, focus, actor category, fact sector, actors per run). Empty for other requests.
constraints: actor_update_subscription.ck_actor_update_subscription_update_request [c] CHECK (((requested_via <> 'actor_updates'::text) OR ((max_usd_per_run IS NOT NULL) AND (update_options ? 'scope'::text))))

comments: column actor_update_subscription.discovery_entity: What a Discovery-page request finds: actor, event or person.
column actor_update_subscription.discovery_options: Event requests: date_from, date_to, event_types. People requests: institution, role.
